name: Midcon Texas / TransTexas Gas Pipeline
monitor_reason: endpoints: threshold leg (b) fails. EIA gives only the state (Texas); no start or end point, no route, and no second source was found (web search was unavailable, session limit). Identity vs the Kinder Morgan Texas Pipeline / Tejas (P0258) systems is also unresolved.
researcher_notes: The EIA pipeline projects release for August 2026, Historical Projects sheet, row 8, lists Midcon Texas/TransTexas Gas Corp. as a completed new pipeline. Operator Midcon Corp. In service October 1996. Texas only. 70 miles, 24 inch, 274 MMcf/d added, interstate, FERC docket CP96-140, cost 17 million dollars. The workbook loaded and names the project. The same docket also appears on a 2003 row for the KM Midcon Texas Pipeline Expansion (8.9 miles, 30 inch, 375 MMcf/d, Kinder Morgan Texas Pipeline), so this line is probably part of what is now the Kinder Morgan Texas system. No matching roster row was found by name. Length of 70 miles is over the 25 km rule and the line is built, but the endpoints are not sourced, so it stays on the monitor list. To finish: find the FERC order for CP96-140 to get endpoints and the owner, then check whether it is already inside P0258 or another Kinder Morgan Texas row. Single source from one EIA release, low confidence. Cost, if staged later, is 17000000 USD.
